notes:
Customer snapshot: large European fintech (core banking B2B) exploring Redwood Private VPC. High security bar — CISO-level mandate for customer-managed keys and complete control over key lifecycle.

Key asks (summarized):
- All in-transit traffic must be mTLS; mutual auth between customer proxies and Redwood agents. No plaintext tunnels.
- At-rest encryption must use customer CMKs (AWS KMS / HSM-backed). Envelope encryption acceptable; customer must be able to rotate keys and trigger rewrap with zero downtime.
- Key rotation policy: customer prefers automated rotation every 90 days; manual rotate API must be supported. Need proof-of-concept for rewrap latency and impact to cached KV.
- Secrets management: integrate with HashiCorp Vault for dynamic DB creds + AWS Secrets Manager for service tokens. Long-lived secrets disallowed except wrapped keys.
- Audit logging: CloudTrail-style logs exported to customer S3; logs must be tamper-evident and retained for 7 years. Need signed delivery receipts and support for on-prem log forwarders.
- Data residency: EU-only processing and storage; strict forbid of cross-region failover without prior approval.
- Network: VPC endpoints / PrivateLink required; no public IPs on inference nodes. Support for IP allowlist and egress firewall rules.

Quotes from calls: "We need to own the keys or we can't move forward" — CISO. "Latency under 40ms p50 for chat during market hours is a hard SLO" — VP Eng.

POC ask: 2-week POC validating mTLS handshake, BYOK KMS integration (rotate + rewrap), audit log export to customer bucket, and secrets retrieval latency from Vault. SE notes: may need dedicated node pool to hit latency + isolation targets.

Open items: legal to review BYOK indemnity clause; confirm Redwood support for HSM-backed external KMS (bring-your-own-HSM) and offline key rotation for on-prem variant. Security wants sample signed log and architecture diagram before procurement sign-off.

CRM shorthand: high-prob deal if BYOK + rotation + logs satisfied. Next = schedule architecture + legal sync (wk of 2026-03-08).
